tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Looks up one city in Audiala's audio-guide catalog and returns a city card: a short summary, the number of audio guides, up to 8 places that have a guide, and links to the city on audiala.com and in the Audiala app. Use this when the user asks what Audiala covers in a named city, or which places there have an audio guide. Do not use it for hotels, restaurants, transport, tickets or opening hours: the catalog has none of these. The catalog covers 1,900+ cities; a city that is not in it returns kind "not_found". Read-only.

name.description: City name. Accents and minor misspellings are tolerated, for example 'Tokyo', 'Tōkyō' or '東京'.

lang.description: Language of the summary and links. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_audio_guide_preview
tools.description: Looks up one landmark, museum or other place in Audiala's audio-guide catalog and returns a place card: a photo, a short summary, a 45-second preview of the narrated audio guide that the user can play in the card, and a link that opens the full guide in the Audiala app. Use this when the user asks for Audiala's audio guide to a specific named place, or asks to hear it. Both the city and the place name are required. Only the 45-second preview plays in the chat; the full narration is in the Audiala app. If the place has no guide, the result lists up to 6 places in that city that do (kind "place_candidates"). Read-only.

city.description: City the place is in, as a name or catalog slug, for example 'Rome' or 'rome'.

monument.description: Name of the landmark, museum or place, for example 'Colosseum'.

lang.description: Language of the guide and its preview. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_trip_planner_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens Audiala's trip planner for one city, in a browser or in the Audiala mobile app, together with up to 8 places in that city that have an audio guide. Use this when the user asks to plan a trip to that city with Audiala, or to continue planning in Audiala. This tool does not build an itinerary and returns no day-by-day plan: the planner does that after the user opens the link. Read-only.

lang.description: Language of the card and links. Defaults to en.

q.description: Optional walk or trip brief to pre-fill in the planner, for example '3 hours around Trastevere, baroque churches and a café stop'.
